entries.name: AWS Activate Founders
entries.value: US$1,000 credits (select startups up to US$5,000 over time)
entries.eligibility: Self-funded, new to Activate credits, working company website, founded in last 10 years.

entries.name: AWS Activate Portfolio
entries.value: Up to US$200,000 credits (some AWS pages still say US$100,000)
entries.eligibility: Needs an Activate Provider Organization ID (VC/accelerator), pre-Series B, founded in last 10 years.

entries.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program (Start/Scale)
entries.value: Up to US$200,000 over 2 years (Y1 100% up to US$100k, Y2 20% up to US$100k)
entries.eligibility: Pre-seed to Series A institutional/VC equity funding; angel, grant, crowdfunding don't qualify; founded within 3-5 yrs; ≤US$5k prior GCP credits.

entries.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program, AI tier
entries.value: Up to US$350,000 over 2 years (Y1 100% up to US$250k)
entries.eligibility: AI-first, Gemini as core of product; Pre-Seed/Seed in last 5 yrs or Series A in last 12 months; founded in last 5 yrs. Third-party models not covered.

entries.name: Microsoft for Startups
entries.value: US$200 immediately; US$5,000 after business verification; up to US$150,000 via usage milestones
entries.eligibility: Registered legal entity for US$5k; higher tiers need 5/7/10+ Azure workloads for 60 days (US$150k also ~US$3k/month usage). No VC needed.

entries.name: Cloudflare for Startups (bootstrapped)
entries.value: US$10,000 credits
entries.eligibility: Bootstrapped / raised under US$1M.

entries.name: Cloudflare for Startups (partner-backed)
entries.value: US$100,000 (<US$5M raised) up to US$350,000 (US$5M+ raised)
entries.eligibility: Needs affiliation with a Cloudflare partner VC/accelerator.

entries.name: Oracle Startup Growth Engine
entries.value: US$5,000 to US$60,000 OCI Universal Credits (12 months)
entries.eligibility: Legally registered tech company with a validated product and a workload for OCI; Oracle selects at its discretion, credits not guaranteed. Launched Oct 2026, replaces Oracle for Startups.

entries.name: DigitalOcean Startups (ex-Hatch)
entries.value: Credits, amount varies (not stated); selected startups invited to GPU credit packages
entries.eligibility: AI-native startups prioritised; raised US$10M or less; company website + company email; service businesses/agencies not eligible.

entries.name: Alibaba Cloud AI Catalyst Program
entries.value: Up to US$120k AI credits + up to 2B free Model Studio tokens
entries.eligibility: not stated on page (selection-based).

entries.name: Huawei Cloud Startup Program
entries.value: Up to USD150,000 Huawei Cloud cash credits voucher
entries.eligibility: Credits and go-to-market support; active in SEA.

entries.name: Tencent Cloud Startup Program
entries.value: not stated (credits/discounts assigned after review)
entries.eligibility: VC-backed startups; verified Tencent Cloud account; reviewed within ~2 weeks.

entries.name: MongoDB for Startups
entries.value: Atlas credits + Voyage AI tokens (amount not stated; Inspire tier for bootstrapped, Grow for funded)
entries.eligibility: <7 years old, Series A or earlier, single software product (agencies excluded), new to program, active website + LinkedIn.

entries.name: Vercel for Startups
entries.value: Up to US$30,000 in Flexible Commitment Amount + Enterprise-tier access
entries.eligibility: 'Eligible teams' (criteria not stated on page).

entries.name: NVIDIA Inception
entries.value: Free membership; partner cloud credits and preferred hardware/software pricing (amount not stated)
entries.eligibility: Free program for AI startups; perks and partner cloud credits.

entries.name: ElevenLabs Startup Grants
entries.value: 12 months free, 33M characters (valued over US$5,500 by ElevenLabs)
entries.eligibility: Business email, monetisation plan, fewer than 25 employees; agencies/consultancies excluded.

entries.name: Claude for Startups
entries.value: Up to US$45,000 in partner offers (Claude Startup Stack); up to US$100,000 extra API credits only via a partner VC
entries.eligibility: Cohort full, no new applications as of 9 Nov 2026, no reopening date. The US$1,000 API credit + free Claude Team year offered in Oct 2026 is no longer listed on the page. Current members keep access.

entries.name: OpenAI for Startups
entries.value: not stated (API credits via VC partners)
entries.eligibility: Requires referral code from an eligible VC partner.

entries.name: Azure OpenAI via Microsoft for Startups
entries.value: Covered by Microsoft for Startups credits (see above)
entries.eligibility: Startup credits usable on Microsoft Foundry models.

entries.name: Amazon Bedrock via AWS Activate
entries.value: Covered by AWS Activate credits
entries.eligibility: Activate credits redeemable on third-party models on Bedrock (Anthropic, Meta, Mistral etc.).

entries.name: Deepgram Startup Program
entries.value: US$1,000 starter credits for direct applicants; tiers up to US$100,000 over 12 months
entries.eligibility: AI builder or early-stage startup, in production or launching within 6 months; >US$10M raised reviewed case by case; needs Deepgram console account.

entries.name: AssemblyAI for Startups
entries.value: Fixed credit amount (not stated), 12 months recurring free credits, then startup discounts
entries.eligibility: Bootstrapped through Series A, building with voice/audio, launching within 6 months.

entries.name: Pinecone for Startups
entries.value: Usage credits and discounts (amount not stated)
entries.eligibility: Fewer than 100 employees; Series A or earlier.

entries.name: Together AI Startup Accelerator
entries.value: Up to US$15K (≤US$5M raised), US$30K (US$5M-10M), US$50K (>US$10M) platform credits
entries.eligibility: Selection-based; tier set by amount raised.

entries.name: Stripe Atlas perks
entries.value: US$500 on incorporation + Treasury account; US$2.5K Stripe credits; US$200K+ partner offers
entries.eligibility: Incorporate a US company via Stripe Atlas (fee applies); US$500 needs Stripe Treasury account within 7 days.

entries.name: Notion for Startups
entries.value: Up to 6 months free Business plan with Notion AI (up to US$12,000 value)
entries.eligibility: Non-paying Notion customers with under 100 employees.

entries.name: HubSpot for Startups
entries.value: 90% off Year 1 (Seed and Series A)
entries.eligibility: Seed (under US$2M raised) and Series A founders.

entries.name: Intercom Early Stage
entries.value: 93% off Intercom + 1 year of Fin free
entries.eligibility: Up to US$10M funding, fewer than 15 employees, not a current Intercom customer.

entries.name: Zendesk for Startups
entries.value: Up to 2 years of Zendesk free
entries.eligibility: 'Qualified startups' (criteria not stated on page).

entries.name: Atlassian for Startups
entries.value: Premium edition $0 for 12 months, up to 50 users
entries.eligibility: Partner accelerator/incubator affiliation; raised no more than US$10M.

entries.name: Miro for Startups
entries.value: Free Miro credits (early startups); up to 25% discount (scale-ups)
entries.eligibility: not stated

entries.name: Linear for Startups
entries.value: not stated (offers via partner VCs/accelerators/communities)
entries.eligibility: Via a Linear startup partner.

entries.name: PostHog for Startups
entries.value: US$50,000 PostHog credits for 12 months + US$12,000 partner benefits
entries.eligibility: Early-stage teams (see page for criteria).

entries.name: Mixpanel for Startups
entries.value: First year free (described as worth US$145,000): full suite, 1B events, 1M Session Replays
entries.eligibility: Startups (criteria on page).

entries.name: GitHub for Startups
entries.value: US$10,000 flexible platform credits
entries.eligibility: Partner-affiliated startups.

entries.name: JetBrains Startup Program
entries.value: 50% off up to 10 IDE subscriptions (all products pack), for up to 5 years
entries.eligibility: Privately owned; established within last 5 years; website/online presence; commercial licences only.

entries.name: Google Workspace via Google for Startups
entries.value: 12 months Google Workspace Business Plus at no cost
entries.eligibility: 12 months Workspace Business Plus for Cloud Program members (verified).

entries.name: Cradle CIP Spark
entries.value: Up to RM150,000 conditional grant, max 18 months
entries.eligibility: 2+ individuals (1 Malaysian, 1 resident) or company <5 yrs, revenue <RM3M, owns IP. No paid-up capital needed.

entries.name: Cradle CIP Sprint
entries.value: Up to RM600,000 conditional convertible grant, max 18 months
entries.eligibility: Sdn Bhd <7 yrs, revenue <RM5M, RM10k paid-up, 2+ directors (1 Malaysian), owns IP.

entries.name: MDEC Digital Content Grant 2026 (Marketing & Commercialisation)
entries.value: Up to RM300,000, up to 100% of eligible cost
entries.eligibility: Malaysian animation/games companies, operating 1+ yr, MD or MSC status. DCG 2026 applications closed 30 Sep 2026; MDEC will announce a reopening.

entries.name: MDEC Digital Content Grant 2026 (Mega)
entries.value: Up to RM2 million, up to 50% of project cost
entries.eligibility: Malaysian animation/games companies; capital/ownership criteria apply. DCG 2026 applications closed 30 Sep 2026.

entries.name: Malaysia Digital (MD) status
entries.value: Tax incentives (not cash); separate MD Tax Incentive application
entries.eligibility: Malaysian-incorporated, resident; MD activity; paid-up capital ≥RM1,000 (RM50,000 for tax incentive). MD tax incentive applications open until 31 Dec 2027.

entries.name: MRANTI programmes (ex-MaGIC)
entries.value: not stated (programmes: Global Accelerator Programme, Global Market Fit, VentureX, etc.)
entries.eligibility: Malaysian Research Accelerator for Technology & Innovation; runs accelerators and commercialisation support.

entries.name: MYStartup (national startup directory)
entries.value: not stated (directory of government/private funding)
entries.eligibility: Directory/single window; individual schemes have own criteria.

entries.name: Startup SG Founder
entries.value: S$20,000 to S$50,000 at 1:1 co-matching
entries.eligibility: First applicant a first-time founder; Pte Ltd <6 months old; 51% SG citizen/PR owned; via Accredited Mentor Partner.

entries.name: Startup SG Tech
entries.value: not stated on page (POC/POV grant, milestone-based; EnterpriseSG holds share-subscription right)
entries.eligibility: Startups with proprietary technology and scalable model.

entries.name: Startup SG Equity
entries.value: Co-investment up to S$12 million (2:1 up to S$1M in first institutional round, then tapering)
entries.eligibility: Singapore-based deep-tech startups with proprietary IP, alongside qualifying investors.

entries.name: Productivity Solutions Grant (PSG)
entries.value: Was up to 50% of eligible costs (cap S$30,000); no new applications
entries.eligibility: Enterprise Singapore's PSG ceased 29 Sep 2026; new applications go to the EDGE Grant (see separate entry). Pre-30 Sep applications still processed. Built Environment PSG (BCA) is separate and still open until it moves to EDGE in Dec 2026.

entries.name: Thailand NIA innovation grants
entries.value: Up to THB 5 million, typically up to 75% of project cost
entries.eligibility: Thai-registered entity, 51%+ Thai owned.

entries.name: DOST-PCIEERD Startup Grant Fund
entries.value: Up to PHP 5 million over 18 months
entries.eligibility: Philippine tech startups; 2026 call ran 3-31 July 2026, next call TBA.

entries.name: L-CAMP Vietnam (Lotte Ventures)
entries.value: Proof-of-concept grants totalling up to US$80,000
entries.eligibility: 2026 applications closed 19 June 2026; watch for next cohort.

entries.name: UGM Startup Grant
entries.value: Up to IDR 12 million
entries.eligibility: UGM students/alumni; 2026 registration closed 27 March 2026.

entries.name: Google for Startups Accelerator: Southeast Asia
entries.value: Equity-free; Google product credits (amount not stated)
entries.eligibility: SEA-based tech startups, Seed to Series B, deeply technical (AI/ML). 2026 applications ran 25 May-20 Jun 2026; register interest for the next cohort.

entries.name: AWS Generative AI Accelerator
entries.value: Up to US$1,000,000 AWS credits (2025 cohort)
entries.eligibility: Early-stage generative AI startups; 8-week program. 2026 window (10 Jun–10 Jul) reported closed; official page not loaded.

entries.name: Antler Singapore (SEA)
entries.value: US$150,000 for ~10% (US$100k SAFE + US$50k uncapped MFN SAFE), up to US$400,000 incl. matching
entries.eligibility: 6-week in-person residency in Singapore (latest started 5 Oct 2026; applications taken continuously for the next one); Malaysia also has a Direct Investment Track for teams with MVP and traction.

entries.name: Iterative
entries.value: US$150K to US$500K investment (equity)
entries.eligibility: SEA-focused batch, twice a year; Winter 2027 applications open.

entries.name: 500 Global Southeast Asia
entries.value: not stated
entries.eligibility: 500.co lists Southeast Asia programmes; no SEA terms found on homepage.

entries.name: Y Combinator
entries.value: US$500,000 standard deal (US$125K for 7% + US$375K uncapped MFN SAFE)
entries.eligibility: Open to SEA founders; equity + SAFE.

entries.name: EDGE Grant (Enterprise Singapore)
entries.value: Up to 50% for SMEs (up to 70% for internationalisation and sustainability); up to S$100,000 grant per year
entries.eligibility: Business registered in Singapore with at least 30% Singaporean/PR ownership; other rules per activity. Replaced EDG, MRA and PSG on 30 Sep 2026; paid on reimbursement after the work is done. No closing date stated.

entries.name: Riverpreneur Challenge (Mekong River Commission)
entries.value: USD 6,000 pilot seed funding for each of 4 winners (USD 24,000 total pool); top 15 get training and mentoring
entries.eligibility: Lead applicant aged 18-35, citizen of Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia or Laos, founder/co-founder of an early-stage venture beyond idea stage (prototype or early revenue) tackling Mekong water, food or circular-economy issues. Deadline 4 Dec 2026; final pitch 3 Apr 2027 in Bangkok.

entries.name: TED Youth Startup: POC (Thailand)
entries.value: Up to THB 1,500,000 partial matching grant
entries.eligibility: For students and young founders at proof-of-concept/prototype stage. Closes 30 Nov 2026. Details from secondary listing (CapEasy, checked 4 Nov 2026); not yet read on the official page.

entries.name: HCMC Creative Startup Project Support 2026 (Digital Technology)
entries.value: Up to 50% of each cost item: up to VND 100m (training), 150m (R&D/pilot), 50m (consulting), 400m (technology) per project
entries.eligibility: Early-stage digital technology startups in Ho Chi Minh City. Closes 30 Nov 2026. Details from secondary listing (CapEasy, checked 4 Nov 2026); not yet read on the official page.
